title: 7th special sitting of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2025/20/ޚޞ/7).
Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Bill.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A special evening sitting called to take up the committee report on the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Bill and vote on it.
